title: Egress proxy ledger
description: What bin/egress-proxy.mjs writes to --ledger when it stops, and what startProxy().stop() in bin/lib/egress-observe.mjs returns in its place when that file could not be read. The stand-in carries destinations null and the reason, so a lane whose ledger was lost never reads as one that dialled nothing.
$comment: Applied by bin/test/egress-observe.test.mjs to a live proxy's ledger. lib/json-schema.mjs has no $ref, so the destination row is repeated in schema/egress-observed.schema.json.

lane.description: The --lane check id; null when the proxy was started without one.

coverage.description: Direct egress is still open to a networked lane, so the ledger covers only clients that honour HTTP(S)_PROXY.

destinations.description: One row per host and port asked for, sorted by host then port.

port.description: A plain-HTTP request takes its URL's port, which can be 0; CONNECT takes 1-65535.

allowed.description: Requests relayed or attempted. A failed DNS lookup counts here and is answered 502.

denied.description: Requests refused by the enforce allowlist.

local.description: Requests refused because the destination resolved to a local, this-host or (with denyPrivate) private address.
